levels.name: Leadership
who: Branch and Edu Pioneers (a status, not a seat)

children.about: Every house reports to the COO.

children.title: General Manager
children.about: Runs the branches: Country Managers, Branch Managers and Trainers. Owns the client journey from enrolment to renewal.
One Country Manager per country. The Malaysia seat is the senior-most across Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand.
Ad hoc operations support, formed when needed.
duties: Ad hoc operations support, formed by the Country Managers when a situation needs it.

children.about: Runs the branch and directs the whole branch team on branch matters, including the Edu-trainer based there. A Branch Manager who earns Branch Pioneer status opens new branches.
Coaches clients. Three tiers: Junior, Senior and Lead.
duties: Coach clients: sessions, onboarding, renewals and referrals in the branch.
Enrolment and doing the job to standard, as trained by Management.
Coaching method and continuous learning come from Education through the branch's Edu-trainer.
Three tiers: Junior, Senior and Lead.
Runs the branch: the team, the schedule, conduct, and the numbers such as sessions, conversion and renewals.
Decides who is hired for the branch after the manager interview. Education's coaching proficiency test is a pass or fail gate.
Directs the whole branch team on branch matters, including the Edu-trainer based there.
A manager who earns Branch Pioneer status opens a new branch, reporting to Expansion until opening day, and hands the old branch to a ready successor.
Runs the branches in their country through the Branch Managers. Owns conversion, renewal and branch performance there.
Co-signs new sites in their country with Expansion, because Management owns the profit afterwards.
Settles a disagreement between a Branch Manager and Education together with the Education Council.
The Malaysia seat is the senior-most Country Manager. David holds the Singapore and Thailand parts until those seats are filled.
Turns leads into clients once a lead is assigned to a branch: first contact, consultation, follow-up, registration and enrolment.
Looks after clients: onboarding, sessions, renewals, referrals and the client who stops coming. Owns the conversion and renewal numbers.
Branch performance after opening day, the Branch Managers and their teams, and branch costs.
Grows managers: names Managers-in-Training, trains them and decides who is ready for which branch.
Co-signs every new site with Expansion. Holds the Country Manager's part for Singapore and Thailand while those seats are open.

children.title: Expansion Director
children.about: Opens new branches: site search, investors, procurement and setup. A Branch Pioneer reports here from the site decision to opening day, then returns to Management House as the new branch's manager. Management co-signs every new site from day one.
Buys for the branches and sets up new sites once the tenancy is signed.
duties: Buys equipment and supplies for all branches, to the approved process and limits.
Sets up new sites once the tenancy is signed: fit-out, procurement and setup to the Studio Setup Framework.
Covers Malaysia, Singapore and Thailand.

children.about: Investors and co-investors for new branches.
duties: Raises funds and brings investors and co-investors on board for new branches, with Finance approving the capital.
Presents the investor reporting and distributions that Finance prepares, for the life of each branch.
Opens new branches: funding, the site, tenancy, fit-out, procurement, setup and the founding team in place by opening day.
Recommends each site; the General Manager or Country Manager co-signs. Expansion steps out on opening day.
Raises the headcount need for each new branch; People & Culture fills it.
Presents to investors, with Finance supplying the numbers. Mentors the Talent Acquisition Lead.

children.title: Chief Technology Officer
children.about: Systems, data and the Client Hub.
Build and run MOVE's software.
duties: Build and run MOVE's software, including the Client Hub.
Builds and runs MOVE's systems: the Client Hub, forms, lead stages and the checks in the system.
Owns data, security and privacy enforcement.
Fixes the system when the system is the problem. Fixing how people use it stays with Management.

children.title: Marketing Director
children.about: Brand, campaigns and enquiries up to the point a lead is assigned to a branch.

duties: Runs campaigns and channels day to day under the Head of Marketing.
Creative and brand assets: design, content and the templates other houses use.
Runs paid advertising and reports lead numbers and cost.
Gets leads in: who we target, where, the ads, the creative, the channels, organic content and the website.
Owns the brand. Every message to a lead or client uses approved templates and brand assets.
Takes the first look at business enquiries and partnership pitches; keeps brand and media partnerships and passes the rest to the right house.
Measured on the number, cost and quality of leads. Hands over when a lead is assigned to a branch and coach.

children.title: Finance Director
children.about: Accounts, payments, payroll and reporting.

duties: Supports the Finance Manager with bookkeeping, claims and records.
Runs accounting, claims and payments day to day under the Head of Finance.
Budgeting, accounting, claims, payroll and payments.
Approves the capital for a new branch, supplies the numbers for investor reporting and pays distributions.
Second pair of eyes on contracts, with the CEO.

children.title: People & Culture Director
children.about: Hiring, contracts, renewals and the people side of the business.
Owns the employment record: offer, contract, renewals and terminations. The Branch Manager decides who is hired.
duties: Offer, contract, records, renewals and terminations for every team member.
Issues contracts drafted through the contract route, collects signatures and files them.

children.about: Finds coaches and managers: sourcing, partnerships and the hiring funnel. Expansion raises the headcount need for each new branch; People & Culture fills it.
duties: Finds candidates: campaigns, partnerships with universities, sports clubs and fitness communities, screening and the shortlist.
Runs the hiring funnel: candidate database and application-to-hire tracking.
Fills the headcount that Management and Expansion raise.
Recruitment from the first ad to the signed contract. Management and Expansion say how many coaches they need, where and by when.
Contracts, renewals, terminations and the employment record. Confirms every offer sits within the agreed headcount and pay band.
Runs the leadership programme both ladders go through, tracks progression at every tier, the 90-day check after each move, and the yearly count of managers and Edu-trainers needed.

children.about: Sets the coaching standard: how MOVE coaches, how coaches are educated, and who is certified. Edu-trainers report here for their education work.

tags.text: branch matters & coaching KPIs: Branch Manager

children.about: Two hats. For educating coaches, their KPIs and their development, they report to the Education Council. For coaching clients and day-to-day branch matters, the Branch Manager directs them like any team member.
duties: Educates the branch's coaches to Education's standard and runs the coaching proficiency test for candidates.
Reports to the Education Council for that work, the education numbers and their own development.
As a trainer, coaches clients and follows the Branch Manager on branch matters like any team member.
Review in two parts, one from each side.
Sets the coaching standard: the method, the syllabus and the format.
Educates coaches and certifies them. The coaching proficiency test is Education's pass or fail gate in hiring.
Picks coaches for the Education track, develops and qualifies Edu-trainers, decides who is ready, and assigns one to each new branch.
Consulted on conversion and renewal and sees the numbers. Not part of enrolment.
Every house reports here. Owns the operating model: who owns what, the handover points between houses and the decision rights.
Every contract comes here first and is drafted from the current template, with the CEO or Head of Finance as a second pair of eyes.
Settles disagreements between houses when the heads cannot.

aside.about: Strategy work for the CEO. Sits under the CEO and is not a house.

entity.sub: Separate entity, outside the L1 to L4 ladder
entity.about: A separate company led by CJ. Not a MOVE reporting line.

branch.intro: Each branch is its own unit. Lines run upward: the Branch Manager to their Country Manager, the Edu-trainer to the Education Council for education work. Inside the branch, the Branch Manager directs everyone on branch matters.
branch.note: One page per branch will follow once the branch list is confirmed. This page shows how every branch is organised.
